question: What is the total revenue from delivered orders?
sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
plan: • Sum the revenue defined as price plus freight_value from order_items. • Join order_items to orders on order_id to filter where order_status = 'delivered'. • No additional grouping needed; aggregate over all rows. • Use only the columns order_items.price, order_items.freight_value, orders.order_status. • Apply the filter order_status = 'delivered' as per project rules. • Return a single numeric value representing total revenue.
